jobs.title: Manufacturing Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Manufacturing Finance Manager to own the operational accounting and financial management across our supply chain and procurement process - from purchase order through delivery, receipt and invoicing. The role sits within our joint venture manufacturing entity and works closely with both the JV's operations team and Auterion's central finance function. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who understands how physical goods move through a production environment and can translate that into accurate, timely financial reporting and management-ready cost visibility.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Own the procurement-to-invoice process end to end - purchase orders, delivery receipts, goods receipt checks and stock movement - ensuring proper matching and controls at each step and maintaining the document-level audit trail required under applicable accounting standards

- Reconcile deliveries against bills of materials and purchase records, working closely with supply chain and systems teams to keep records accurate and up to date

- Turn delivery and receipt data into accurate, on-time invoicing and build repeatable monthly reconciliation processes

- Identify and correctly account for items delivered outside standard/contracted pricing agreements

- Track actual production costs (direct materials, labor, and overhead) against contract value and budget. Surfacing variances early so operations and management can act swiftly

- Maintain and reconcile WIP balances by production order; tracking physical production progress against system records, supporting accurate period-end inventory valuation and COGS recognition

- Support the build-out of financial controls across procurement and spend, including approval workflows and spend visibility

- Act as the finance counterpart to supply chain and operations teams, providing cost visibility, variance analysis, and the financial and cash-flow impact of production activity

- Maintain a regular on-site presence to verify physical inventory and operations against system records

- Track and control operational spend against budget, including cost category visibility, variance reporting, and enforcement of non-production spend approvals.

Qualifications and Skills

- Experience in supply chain, procurement, or operations finance - manufacturing or hardware environments strongly preferred

- Comfortable working directly with bills of materials, purchase orders and delivery documentation

- Hands-on cost accounting experience in a manufacturing environment: WIP tracking, standard vs. actual cost variance, inventory valuation

- Strong reconciliation and process-control mindset; comfortable building structure where processes are still maturing

- Proven ERP ownership in a manufacturing or supply chain environment required. You build and own processes, not just use them. NetSuite experience is a plus.

- Clear communicator, comfortable working cross-functionally with supply chain, operations and finance stakeholders

- On-site presence required as this role works directly with production and receiving teams and cannot be performed remotely.

- Fluent in German, with a solid understanding of the German accounting and financial reporting environment.

Benefits

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Pension plan

- Extended social security package

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Wellpass membership

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Supply Chain Specialist, you will be responsible for the end-to-end supply chain processes of Auterion products. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and external partners, while providing the overall strategic and operational oversight necessary to ensure excellence across our global value chain.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Run the planning, controlling, and optimization of supply chain processes, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, scheduling, and order management

- Identify and eliminate bottlenecks, redundancies, and inefficiencies across the supply chain

- Serve as the primary operational go-to person between purchasing, production planning, logistics, engineering and sales — ensuring information flows smoothly and handoffs are seamless

- Identify, design, and implement improvements to supply chain processes and tools, including  ERP configuration, reporting enhancements, and workflow automation

- Document processes, develop standard operating procedures, and drive adoption

- Prepare and analyze reports, providing timely and accurate reporting on KPIs (e.g., delivery performance, inventory levels)

- Actively support daily operations and cross-functional projects

- Act as the first point of escalation for supply disruptions, component shortages, and logistics failures — driving rapid, solution-oriented resolution with minimal business impact

- Oversee daily supply chain operations - ensuring purchase orders, shipments, and inventory movements are executed on time and in full

- Maintain contingency plans and alternative sourcing strategies for critical components and high-risk supply categories

- Manage relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and other partners

Qualifications and Skills

- 2+ years of professional experience in a supply chain-related role (e.g., logistics, planning, procurement, customer service)

- Strong hands-on mentality – willing to support operational tasks as needed

- High level of flexibility, motivation, and reliability

- Confident use of Google Workspace (Gsuite)

- Experience with ERP systems, ideally NetSuite

- Solid Excel skills and quick understanding of digital tools

- Fluency in English (spoken and written) is required, German skills are a plus

- Team player with a structured and proactive working style and strong communication skills

- US Citizenship required

Base Salary Range:  $100,000 - $140,000

Benefits

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Unlimited PTO

- Health Insurance (includes dental & vision)

- Medical flex spending

- Life Insurance

- Retirement Plan - 401k with company match

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
